exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Tell/Instruct to Do Something".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ように言う matches "Tell/Instruct to Do Something".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ように言う.
exercises.explanation: Used to report telling or instructing someone to do something.
